column1: # Lone-surrogate refusals of the sign-in and install routes: go-api against auth-service (D6129).

# Each row is DRIVEN by a test: the request is sent to the go-api handler and the status, the error type and the error loc are asserted. internal/api/sso (unit rows: setup none; stack rows: setup saml_*) and internal/api/githubapp read this file by the package column.

# id<TAB>package<TAB>request<TAB>body<TAB>setup<TAB>go_api<TAB>auth_service<TAB>kind<TAB>reason   (go_api: "<status> <type> <loc>" or "<status>"; kind: same | stricter | divergent; a stricter or divergent row names its reason)

column9: Python urlencode raised on the surrogate and answered 500; go-api answered 200 with the percent-encoded bytes and sealed them with U+FFFD; it now refuses at validation as string_unicode (acp 2026-10-26); the auth-service twin (encoding/json decode turned the escape into U+FFFD and answered 200) refuses it the same way from the raw body (acp 2026-10-26)

on an allow_idp_initiated provider relay_state is forwarded into the redirect_url query; Python urlencode raised (500) and go-api answered 200 with the percent-encoded bytes; it now refuses as string_unicode after the provider lookup (acp 2026-10-26); the auth-service twin (encoding/json decode turned the escape into U+FFFD and answered 200) refuses it the same way from the raw body (acp 2026-10-26)

go-api replaces the caller value with its own sealed token on a provider that does not allow IdP-initiated sign-in and answers 200; the auth-service twin has no sealed branch, forwards relay_state into the redirect URL on every provider, and so refuses a lone surrogate on every provider (acp 2026-10-26: named gap, no AllowIdpInitiated mirror in the twin)
the OAuth authorize route reads the body for its shape and never reads redirect_uri on either plane, so a lone surrogate there reaches no URL or state and is not refused

setup_action is written into the credential json config as an escape the json column accepts, so Python and go-api both answered 2xx and stored a lone surrogate; it now refuses at validation as string_unicode (acp 2026-10-26); the auth-service plane has no such route
